outcome: Health-related quality of life (36-Item Short-Form General Health Survey)
cohort: Participants were 414 women with gestational diabetes who consented to complete perinatal mental health questionnaires in the TARGET Trial across 10 hospitals in New Zealand.
finding: No differences were found between randomised glycaemic target groups in composite poor mental health outcomes or their components at 36 weeks' gestation and 6 months postpartum.
